learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the tiny words that show location, time, and direction, plus the magical combos called phrasal verbs!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Prepositions are short words that show where something is or when something happens. They connect nouns to the rest of the sentence. Words like 'in', 'on', 'under', and 'behind' are location prepositions!
These tell us exactly when an event takes place. We use 'at' for a specific time (at 5 PM), 'on' for days and dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months or years (in 2023).
A Phrasal Verb is a fun team-up! When you mix a verb with a preposition, it creates a completely brand-new meaning. For example, 'give' means to hand over, but 'give up' means to quit!

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ The Secret Treasure Map
fun_activity.instructions: Hide a small toy in your room. Write down three clue sentences using Prepositions of Place (like under the bed, behind the door) to help your family find the treasure!

quick_recap: ⭐ Prepositions show the relationship of a noun or pronoun to other words regarding time, place, or direction.
⭐ Phrasal verbs combine a verb and a preposition to create a totally different, exciting meaning.
